decisions.scenario: Booking Alexander Bed and Breakfast for five people for two nights

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: There are ten cheap places with free Wi-Fi. Do you have a preferred area?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: I recommend Alexander Bed and Breakfast in the centre. Would you like me to make a booking?

turns.speaker: Learner

turns.speaker: Assistant
